title: AgileGraph Expert Review Annotation Template
description: Template format for external cybersecurity reviewers to independently evaluate cryptographic migration risk. Real expert annotations must be filled by verified reviewers; synthetic or hallucinated data is prohibited.

categories.HIGH: Assets employing broken asymmetric cryptography (e.g. RSA < 3072, ECC/ECDSA, DSA, DH) susceptible to Shor's algorithm on a CRQC, or broken symmetric/hash primitives (MD5, SHA1, DES, RC4) in sensitive paths.
categories.MEDIUM: Assets with intermediate risk (e.g. SHA-256 in high-exposure signatures, large-key RSA 4096 in isolated modules, or symmetric primitives requiring quantum-safe key lengthening).
categories.LOW: Assets employing quantum-resistant primitives (AES-256, ChaCha20, SHA-3, ML-KEM, ML-DSA) or non-sensitive, isolated cryptographic operations.

annotations.rationale: RSA-2048 key exchange is vulnerable to Shor's algorithm on a CRQC. Subject to Harvest Now, Decrypt Later threats.
